requirements.text: The institution establishes trading desks and assigns each trading book position to one desk only where the position complies with the desk's business strategy and is managed and monitored consistently.
requirements.level_reason: The establishment of trading desks and position assignment is evidenced in the trading desk structure and trading book policy, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Art. 104b is outside Chapter 1b but is a permission condition under Art. 325az(2)(a).

requirements.text: The institution provides a rationale for including each trading desk in the IMA scope, which is not motivated by the standardised approach yielding lower own funds requirements.
requirements.level_reason: The rationale for the IMA desk scope is part of the institution's permission application to the competent authority.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Motivation restriction in the second subparagraph of Art. 325az(2).

requirements.text: The institution immediately notifies the competent authority when a trading desk no longer meets a permission condition and calculates that desk's own funds requirements under the alternative standardised approach until compliance is restored.
requirements.level_reason: Notification of desks no longer meeting permission conditions is an obligation of the institution towards the competent authority.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Material changes and extensions of the IMA, and material changes to the reduced set of modellable risk factors, obtain prior permission; all other changes and extensions are notified.
requirements.level_reason: Prior permission and notification of IMA changes are obligations of the institution towards the competent authority, evidenced in permission records.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Materiality criteria in RTS under Art. 325az(8)(a).

requirements.text: The IMA own funds requirement equals the higher of previous-day ES plus stress scenario measure, and the multiplication factor times the 60-business-day average ES plus the 60-business-day average stress scenario measure.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The institution's own credit spreads are excluded from the ES and stress scenario measures for positions in its own debt instruments.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Added by CRR3.

requirements.text: The default risk charge equals the higher of the most recent internal default risk model requirement and its average over the preceding 12 weeks.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The ES risk measure combines the unconstrained ES across all broad risk factor categories and the sum of the unconstrained ES per broad category with a supervisory correlation ρ = 50 %.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Formula rendered as image in the source; parameter ρ and structure confirmed from the definitions.

requirements.text: Partial expected shortfall measures are calculated daily at a 97.5th percentile, one-tailed confidence level.
requirements.quote: at 97,5th percentile, one tailed confidence interval
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Partial ES is scaled from a 10-day base horizon to liquidity horizons of 10, 20, 40, 60 and 120 days, shocking for each horizon only risk factors whose effective liquidity horizon is equal or longer.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Table 1 of Art. 325bc confirmed.

requirements.text: The reduced set of modellable risk factors explains at least 75 % of the full-set current ES over the preceding 60 business days; a breach is notified immediately and remedied within two weeks.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Ratio condition is a formula image not in the extracted text; 75 % taken from the Basel standard (MAR33.5) and CRR2 — confirm.

requirements.text: Stressed ES inputs are calibrated to a continuous 12-month stress period identified to maximise the reduced-set stressed ES, searched over an observation period starting no later than 1 January 2007.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Data inputs for the current-period partial ES measures are calibrated to the preceding 12 months and updated at least monthly.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Criteria on data accuracy and calibration where data are insufficient to follow from the RTS under Art. 325bc(6) (CRR3).

requirements.text: Each risk factor of IMA desk positions is mapped to one broad risk factor category and one broad sub-category of Table 2, which determines its liquidity horizon.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The appropriateness of the risk factor liquidity horizon mapping is verified at least monthly.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The modellability of all risk factors of positions on IMA desks is assessed, using third-party vendor data only where permitted by the competent authority.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Criteria and frequency in the RFET RTS under Art. 325be(3) (CRR3 mandate); original RTS Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2060.

requirements.text: Own funds requirements for risk factors assessed as non-modellable are calculated with the stress scenario risk measure of Article 325bk.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The institution develops appropriate extreme scenarios of future shock for all non-modellable risk factors, to the satisfaction of the competent authority.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Scenario design and aggregation per SSRM RTS under Art. 325bk(3).

requirements.text: The back-testing VaR uses a one-day holding period, shocks only modellable risk factors in the PLA risk factor list, uses current 12-month calibration data and otherwise the ES model assumptions.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Daily overshootings are counted per trading desk on both hypothetical and actual changes in portfolio value.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: A trading desk meets back-testing requirements if, over the latest 250 business days, it has no more than 12 overshootings at 99 % and no more than 30 at 97.5 %, each on hypothetical and actual P&L.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Hypothetical changes compare end-of-day value with next-day value assuming unchanged positions; actual changes compare with the actual next-day value excluding fees and commissions.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Technical elements per RTS under Art. 325bf(9).

requirements.text: The multiplication factor is at least 1.5 plus an add-on from Table 3 (0 below 5 up to 0.50 above 9 overshootings), based on the higher of hypothetical and actual 99 % VaR overshootings over 250 days.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Overshootings are notified to the competent authority with an explanation promptly and no later than five business days after occurrence.
requirements.level_reason: Notification of back-testing overshootings is a supervisory reporting obligation evidenced in regulatory correspondence.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Each IMA desk demonstrates that risk-theoretical P&L from the risk-measurement model is close or sufficiently close to hypothetical P&L from the pricing model.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). CRR3 wording; test metrics and frequency in the PLA RTS under Art. 325bg(4).

requirements.text: For desks whose P&L attribution result is only sufficiently close, an additional own funds requirement is calculated for all positions on that desk.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). PLA add-on introduced by CRR3; enters Art. 325ba(3).

requirements.text: The institution documents a precise list of risk-measurement model risk factors used for back-testing, based on PLA results, and tracks all changes to that list.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The risk-measurement model captures at least the standardised-approach risk factors unless omission has no material PLA impact, and the institution can explain risk factors in pricing but not in risk models.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The risk-measurement model captures nonlinearities of options and other products, as well as correlation risk and basis risk.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: For material interest rate exposures in major currencies, yield curves are modelled with at least six maturity segments and spread risk between imperfectly correlated curves is captured.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Proxies are used only where data are insufficient, show a good track record for the actual position and are appropriately conservative.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The internal risk-measurement model is closely integrated into daily risk management and is the basis for reporting risk exposures to senior management.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: An independent risk control unit reporting to senior management designs and implements the IMA models, owns the overall risk management system and produces daily reports on model output and limits.
requirements.level_reason: The organisation and mandate of the independent risk control unit are evidenced in organisational documents, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). CRR3 wording.

requirements.text: A validation unit separate from the risk control unit performs the initial and ongoing validation of all internal risk-measurement models used in the IMA.
requirements.quote: shall conduct the initial and ongoing validation of any internal risk-measurement model used in the alternative internal model approach
requirements.level_reason: The separation of the validation unit from the risk control unit is an organisational requirement evidenced in the validation function's mandate.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Added by CRR3.

requirements.text: A rigorous stress testing programme, including reverse stress tests, covers the internal models, with results reviewed by senior management at least monthly.
requirements.level_reason: The market risk stress testing programme and its senior management review are evidenced in the institution's stress testing framework and committee minutes.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The overall risk management process is reviewed at least annually, including accuracy and completeness of position data, data proxies and the consistency, timeliness, reliability and independence of data sources.
requirements.level_reason: The annual review of the overall risk management process is an institution-level review evidenced in internal audit reports.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Review scope listed in points (a)–(h); data items in points (e) and (f).

requirements.text: Internal models are validated by qualified parties independent of development at initial development, after significant changes, periodically, and after significant structural market or portfolio changes.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Validation goes beyond regulatory back-testing and PLA and includes tests of model assumptions, own back-testing relevant to portfolio risks, and hypothetical portfolios covering basis, concentration and proxy risks.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The internal default risk model measures default losses as a 99.9 % value-at-risk over a one-year horizon, with equity default modelled as a price of zero.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). Point (b) for equity default; 60-day equity horizon option in Art. 325bn(3).

requirements.text: Default correlations are based on credit spread or equity price data covering at least 10 years including the ES stress period, and are calibrated to a one-year horizon.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: The default risk charge is calculated at least weekly.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.chapter: Default risk charge — PD and LGD
requirements.text: Default probabilities are floored at 0.03 %, or at 0.01 % for 0 % risk-weighted exposures and 10 % risk-weighted covered bonds.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623). CRR3 floor values.

requirements.chapter: Default risk charge — PD and LGD
requirements.text: Default probabilities use at least five years of historical default and default-equivalent price decline data, and are not inferred solely from current market prices.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Validation of the default risk model verifies correlation and systematic-factor choices, applies stress and sensitivity tests beyond past events, and uses quantitative benchmarks.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).

requirements.text: Internal models are documented so that correlation and other modelling assumptions are transparent to the competent authority.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623).
